title: ReflectoGen: Physics-Inspired and Calibration-Enabled Reflectogram Synthesis for Pile Integrity Testing
description: ReflectoGen is a calibration-enabled, physics-inspired Python software package for synthetic reflectogram generation in low-strain pile integrity testing. It provides single-case generation, batch dataset construction, waveform/profile CSV export, and archive-based calibration against existing reflectogram collections.
